instructions.purpose: Delete a saved automation on the user's request.

tool.name: automation-delete
tool.description: Deletes the automation and its drafts and removes it from cron jobs. Returns updatedJobs (jobs that kept their other content) and cancelledJobs (jobs that had nothing else to do).

usage_rules.rule: Delete only when the user asks to delete that automation.
Always report updatedJobs and cancelledJobs so the user knows which schedules lost it.
